messages:
rachael: quick postmortem follow-up for the Helios dedicated outage. root cause looks like a peering config rollout + an on-prem NAT behavior that exhausted conntrack entries during a SYN surge. documenting owners + timelines here.

tom: can we enumerate immediate mitigations vs medium/long-term? want clear deadlines for CS.

rachael: immediate: bump conntrack table and hold peering rollouts for affected tenants (done). medium: patch peering retry/backoff + small canary gating. long: automation for rollback + monthly recurrence review.

ojas: i'll take the peering rollback automation. plan: job that detects >3 resets/15m per-tenant -> run rollback to last-known-good and open a P1. prototype in 7 days.

kevin: i'll own the recurrence analysis. running SQL across incident tags to find deploy correlations and traffic windows. deliverable: a short report + recommendations in 5 business days.

olivia: CS asks for 48h ETA to customers and a follow-up note at 7 days. i'll draft the customer note once we have ticket links. pls tag me when done. @rachael

samir: temporary mitigation we applied: increased conntrack_max by 30%, applied a throttle on peer connect attempts for the affected tenant, and held 2 active peering rollouts. noted in the incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-2410

ticket-bot: created issues: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-311 (conntrack tuning), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RBK-210 (rollback automation), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PEER-119 (peering retry/backoff), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REC-77 (recurrence analysis), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RUN-88 (runbook updates).

ojas: draft automation snippet: 
```
# detect peering resets and rollback
resets = query_metric('net.peering.resets', tenant=tid, window='15m')
if resets > 3:
  run_playbook('peering.rollback', tenant=tid)
  alert('SRE', severity='P1')
```
will add safe guards & dry-run mode.

rachael: timelines: NET-311 hotfix in 48h (owner: samir), PEER-119 patch in 10 days (ojas), RBK-210 automation in 3 weeks (ojas + infra), RUN-88 runbook updated in 7 days (rachael). REC-77 report in 5 days (kevin).

tom: please include exact CLI for the hotfix so CS can reference it.

samir: hotfix CLI we ran (for docs): `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and `echo 30 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established_backup`. also monitoring rule added: alert when conntrack.usage_pct > 65%.

kevin: recurrence detection query basics (will expand): `select incident_id, deploy_id, timestamp from incidents where tags like '%peering%' and timestamp between now()-90d and now()` then join with deploy table. will share notebook link.

olivia: thanks. CS wants a short bulleted timeline to send to Helios by EOD today. rachael can you paste one in this thread?

rachael: copy-paste for CS: 
- 0-48h: applied conntrack headroom increase + temporary peer hold (done).
- 48h: NET-311 hotfix verification (samir).
- 10 days: PEER-119 runtime patch and small canary rollout (ojas).
- 7 days: RUN-88 runbook + CLI snippets (rachael).
- 3 weeks: RBK-210 automation -> auto-rollback + alerting (ojas).
- 5 days: REC-77 recurrence report and gating recommendations (kevin).

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deployment for PEER-119 on 2026-04-06 02:00 UTC (dry-run).

otjas: small correction: automation will only auto-rollback in dry-run mode for first 2 weeks, then auto-enforce if stable.

tom: please add owner links / PR links as they appear. also set a calendar invite for a 30m remediation sync midweek.

rachael: created calendar: "Helios remed follow-up" Wed 2026-03-31 16:00 UTC. invite sent.

samir: PR links: NET-311 PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/conntrack-fix/pull/12; PEER-119 draft: https://git.redwood.ai/serving/peering-retries/pull/3; RBK-210 branch: https://git.redwood.ai/ops/rollback-automation/tree/wip.

kevin: will also surface any tenants with repeated peering churn to ops so we can run tenant-specific mitigations.

olivia: CS ack, will circulate the EOD note with timeline and ping Helios.

rachael: final ask: any follow-up QA tests we should run post-patch? suggest: a synthetic SYN burst test + steady-state KV-cache validation on runtime. share harness links pls.

ojas: i'll drop the harness repo here once I finish: https://git.redwood.ai/test/harnesses/peering-sim (WIP). initial commands: `ab -n 20000 -c 200 http://canary.helix/health` and `sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem loss 0.2% delay 40ms`.

ticket-bot: updated PM-2410: linked NET-311, PEER-119, RBK-210, REC-77, RUN-88.

tom: thanks all. ack.

rachael: ack.

ojas: ack.

kevin: ack.

olivia: ack.
